uncertainty.benchmark_applicability: no benchmark was used: the NASA PCoE Li-ion aging dataset (repository-pinned; 18650 cells) has a Forge-authored reference record with one envelope term (cell format) that this flagship cannot state for its parameter set, so its applicability is UNKNOWN and it is not compared
material_provenance: PyBaMM parameter set Chen2020 (provider-bundled literature set)
uncertainty.model_applicability: cell temperature window [273.15, 333.15] K and SOC window [0.15, 0.95] were checked on every solved day; the aging map range [0, 0.5) on the slow state. The applicability of the Chen2020 parameters to the temperatures and duty of this case is UNKNOWN to Forge
uncertainty.model_discrepancy: NOT QUANTIFIED for the DFN cell model, the quasi-steady thermal rule, the loss-of-active-material fade mapping or the representative-day approximation (unknown, not zero). Reported, not propagated: against LG M50 lab discharges at C/2 the cell model's voltage RMSE was 13.6-16.9 mV and its peak surface-rise error -3.5 to -1.5 K (big14-a-lgm50-dfn; in-sample, likely optimistic). The rise error belongs to the lab rig (its identified heat-transfer coefficient, a lumped model against a surface thermocouple) and says nothing about this flagship's cell temperature, which follows the declared contact-resistance rule; the charge half of the duty was never compared with data; applicability to this module and duty is UNKNOWN
unknown_input_uncertainty: active-material balance factors (identified on one LG M50 curve, not measured)

levels.note: the CELL MODEL alone was compared with measured LG M50 lab discharges (big14-a-lgm50-dfn, pre-registered): NOT MET (C/2: voltage RMSE inside the criterion on all 3 cells; capacity inside the criterion on all 3 cells; surface-temperature rise missed on cell02, cell04), and in-sample (Chen2020 was tuned on those curves), so it is neither validation nor evidence about this module, cold plate or duty. The NASA PCoE Li-ion aging dataset (repository-pinned manifest) was also considered: the reference record Forge wrote for it (envelope authored here from the pack's description, not from the dataset's own metadata) states only the cell-format diameter (18 mm, from the '18650' name) as an envelope term and this flagship states no recorded cell format for the PyBaMM parameter set, so its applicability is UNKNOWN (condition 'cell_format_diameter' of the flagship is not stated); no comparison was made and none is claimed
